title: Only Minuteman launched from a silo, at November 2
place_text: November 2 launch facility, Ellsworth missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: the only missile that ever flew out of the ground in the minute man program was at November 2 where I was located not during my time but in the 60s and I believe it flew for 5 seconds

plain: The only missile that ever flew out of the ground in the Minuteman programme, America's land-based nuclear missiles kept in underground silos, did it in the 1960s from a launch site called November 2, in the missile field around Ellsworth in South Dakota, and it flew for about five seconds. That is what Mario Woods, a former guard at nuclear missile sites, tells Michels. Woods was later posted at November 2 himself, though not when the launch happened, and he says only that he believes the flight lasted five seconds.
